title: North Korea tells UN that South Korea 'fabricated' border landmine blast
detail: North Korea told the United Nations that South Korea 'fabricated' a landmine blast at the inter-Korean border, according to the South China Morning Post on Oct 26.

title: Swiss foreign minister to hold talks in North Korea this week
detail: Switzerland's foreign minister is set to hold talks in North Korea this week, according to The Straits Times on Oct 26.
